findings.subject: Do not publish legacy auth sequences as current architecture
findings.detail: API core and frontend still describe path-based token/org gates and GitHub platform sign-in, while the current host uses endpoint-classified Entra/broker authentication and project roles. Assistant prose/sequence forwards an Entra caller token to MCP, which accepts only broker tokens. This is a blocker to approving those diagrams as current, not a request to modify runtime security code.

findings.subject: Production event delivery is database polling, not universal replay-to-channel
findings.detail: Merge the accurate 00-system-overview-fig8 production sequence into canonical-durable-event-stream-sequence, then move its sole consumer. Request shared-owner reconciliation of canonical-durable-event-stream and canonical-event-replay-tail if they imply per-replica channels provide cross-replica delivery; no foreign entry was edited.

findings.subject: Assistant Idle is not a terminal Completed run
findings.detail: The page's revival of Completed runs is obsolete. Idle conversations CAS-wake; a Completed row or durable run.completed seal returns 409 operator_run_closed. Preserve the 5/30 minute timers and held-pod behavior while correcting the lifecycle.

findings.subject: The all-MAF and all-RequestPort slogans have exceptions
findings.detail: Collective AssemblyReviewGate is service-driven and uses TaskCompletionSource; Operator conversations are a separate runtime path. The existing D3 handoff graphic is useful precisely because it prevents this conflation.

findings.subject: Data topology and child-workspace prose disagree with implementation
findings.detail: The legacy data graph says single writer/SqliteDb while production uses shared EF/Postgres and separate workers. The persistence page additionally says coordinator children share one worktree; actual StartChildRunAsync provisions each child its own. Consolidate README onto email-architecture after publication review, retain external copies as derived exports, and retire two unused root Excalidraw sources whose auth/storage labels are stale.

findings.subject: No active workflow-catalog or landing SVG consumer found
findings.detail: A read-only docs SVG enumeration returned no SVG assets in this worktree; basename searches found no workflow/landing SVG import or embed. WorkflowProof loads the product React demonstration and the landing page uses screenshots. The seven retained workflow PNG families need intentional root-library consumers, not invented SVG consumers. Coordinator's full mechanical scan remains authoritative for asset integrity.

findings.subject: Published authoring instructions describe target state while provenance still says edit JSON
findings.detail: The renderer accepts both JSON and draw.io sources; many image provenance comments, including the root event-stream page, instruct editing JSON. This research does not migrate sources. Later canonical promotion must update source provenance and export stamps without modifying shipped product rendering or removing shared runtime dependencies.

findings.subject: Research-only status and ownership
findings.detail: All assigned pages and 33 owned diagrams have explicit dispositions. Source structures and code/config/tests were inspected, not rendered PNG pixels. Retain means no identified semantic defect, not completed pitch/iterate or publication approval. Coordinator architecture pilot was read-only. Cross-owner targets are recommendations for central reconciliation, never permission for this worker to edit foreign files.
